snippet.title: Jiaohun: Gameplay Trailer | The Horror Game Awards 2026
snippet.description:
"JIAOHUN is a cinematic first-person psychological horror game set in a small Chinese town during the 1990s. You will gradually uncover the mystery behind the downfall of Fairy Town.The game is scheduled for release in 2027 on PC (Steam) and PlayStation 5.

Wishlist now: 
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3550940
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10020536

Follow us:
X: https://x.com/JiaoHun_game
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/qqwAVR7amR
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@jiaohun"---
Originally aired during The Horror Game Awards 2026 on Friday 20 November 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.

Website: https://thehorrorgameawards.com/
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/TheHorrorGameAwards

Discord: https://discord.gg/j8wUUzJQ8D
Twitter: https://twitter.com/HorrorGameAward
Instagram: https://instagram.com/thehorrorgameawards
